questions.question: What is the prescribed upload format, dimensions, and file size limit for Annexure A certificate uploads?
questions.whyItMatters: This determines the technical validation rules and UI constraints for the document upload module.
suggestedAnswers: PDF format, maximum 2 MB, 300 DPI
PDF/JPEG, maximum 1 MB, 200 DPI
PDF only, maximum 5 MB, 300 DPI
Any image/PDF format, maximum 2 MB
questions.defaultAssumption: The Directorate shall assume a maximum file size of 2 MB and PDF format, to be validated during UAT.

questions.question: To which specific authority shall applications delayed beyond the mandated timelines be escalated?
questions.whyItMatters: This defines the escalation workflow and notification triggers in the SLA monitoring dashboard.
suggestedAnswers: Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department
Director, Department of Social Welfare
State Nodal Officer for e-Governance
Chief Secretary to the State Government
questions.defaultAssumption: The Directorate shall assume escalation to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department.

questions.question: What is the prescribed procedure and timeframe for an applicant to appeal against a rejection?
questions.whyItMatters: This is required to build the appeal submission, routing, and decision logging workflow in the portal.
suggestedAnswers: Submit a written appeal to the District Social Welfare Officer within 15 days
Submit an online appeal to the State Nodal Officer within 30 days
Submit a grievance through the online portal within 7 working days
No appeal process is required
questions.defaultAssumption: The Directorate shall assume applicants may submit an online appeal within 30 days of rejection.

questions.question: What are the procedures and timelines for handling Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) failures such as non-Aadhaar-seeded or closed bank accounts?
questions.whyItMatters: This dictates the error handling, retry logic, and re-verification workflow for the payment module.
suggestedAnswers: The bank account shall be re-seeded with Aadhaar within 7 working days
The applicant shall be notified and given 15 days to update details
The payment shall be reversed to the treasury within 30 days
The scholarship shall be held in a suspense account pending correction
questions.defaultAssumption: The Directorate shall assume the applicant shall be notified via SMS and given 15 working days to update the bank details.

questions.question: What is the exact renewal window, and how is the renewal process initiated by the applicant?
questions.whyItMatters: This defines the automated renewal triggers and the UI for the renewal application flow.
suggestedAnswers: Renewal opens 30 days before the academic year ends, initiated by the institution
Renewal opens on 1 April, initiated by the applicant logging into the portal
Renewal opens 60 days before the academic year ends, initiated by the applicant
Renewal is automatic based on previous year's attendance and income
questions.defaultAssumption: The Directorate shall assume the renewal window opens 60 days before the start of the new academic year, initiated by the applicant.

questions.question: What is the prescribed data retention period for personal data collected under the scheme?
questions.whyItMatters: This determines the database archiving policy and the automated deletion schedule.
suggestedAnswers: 5 years from the date of application
7 years from the end of the academic year
10 years from the date of last payment
As per the DPDP Act 2023 retention schedule
questions.defaultAssumption: The Directorate shall assume a retention period of 7 years from the end of the academic year.

questions.question: What is the direction for migrating existing paper records and current beneficiaries to the new online system?
questions.whyItMatters: This defines the data migration scope, format, and validation rules for the legacy system.
suggestedAnswers: All existing records shall be digitised and uploaded by the District Social Welfare Offices
Only current beneficiaries shall be migrated with a one-time Aadhaar verification
No legacy data shall be migrated; fresh applications only
Existing records shall be retained in physical format only
questions.defaultAssumption: The Directorate shall assume existing paper records shall be digitised and uploaded by the District Social Welfare Offices.

questions.question: What is the required audit trail mechanism and frequency for logging application processing actions?
questions.whyItMatters: This dictates the database logging schema and the reporting interface for compliance.
suggestedAnswers: Every action shall be logged with user ID and timestamp, reviewed monthly
Every action shall be logged with user ID and timestamp, reviewed quarterly
Only rejections and payments shall be logged, reviewed annually
No formal audit trail is required beyond the monthly report to the Principal Secretary
questions.defaultAssumption: The Directorate shall assume every action shall be logged with user ID and timestamp, and reviewed monthly.

blocks.SOURCES:
[GO-1] (Info) The State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme is presently administered through paper applications submitted at institutions and forwarded to District Social Welfare Offices. Applications take 6 to 9 months to be sanctioned, files are lost in transit, and students have no means of knowing the status of their application.
[GO-2] (Info) Government has decided that all applications under the scheme, fresh and renewal, shall be received, verified, sanctioned and paid online from the academic year 2026-27, so that eligible students receive the scholarship in a transparent and time-bound manner.
[GO-3.1] (Rule) The applicant shall be a domicile of Rajyapradesh.
[GO-3.3] (Rule) The applicant shall be studying in a post-matric course in an institution recognised by the competent authority in Rajyapradesh.
[GO-3.4] (Rule) For renewal, the applicant shall have attended at least 75% of classes in the previous academic year, as certified by the institution.
[GO-4.1] (Mandate) Applications shall be submitted online through the scholarship portal or through Common Service Centres (CSCs).
[GO-4.2] (Mandate) Aadhaar-based e-KYC of the applicant shall be mandatory.
[GO-4.3] (Mandate) Caste and income certificates shall be obtained from DigiLocker where available; otherwise the applicant shall upload the certificate in the prescribed format in Annexure A.
[GO-5.1] (Timeline) The nodal officer of the institution shall verify the application within 15 days of submission.
[GO-5.2] (Timeline) The District Social Welfare Officer shall sanction or reject the verified application within 15 days of receipt.
[GO-5.3] (Mandate) Reasons shall be recorded in writing for every rejection and communicated to the applicant.
[GO-6.1] (Mandate) The scholarship shall be paid through Direct Benefit Transfer using PFMS to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant.
[GO-6.2] (Timeline) The scholarship shall be paid in a single instalment not later than 31 March of the academic year.
[GO-7.1] (Mandate) An online grievance facility shall be provided to applicants.
[GO-7.2] (Mandate) The applicant shall be informed by SMS at every stage of processing of the application.
[GO-7.3] (Timeline) Grievances shall be resolved within 7 working days of receipt.
[GO-8.1] (Mandate) A dashboard shall be provided to the District Social Welfare Officer showing district-wise status of applications.
[GO-8.2] (Mandate) A monthly report shall be submitted to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department.
[GO-9] (Timeline) The scholarship shall be sanctioned within 30 working days of submission of a complete application, and the service is notified under the Rajyapradesh Right to Service Act.
[GO-10] (Mandate) Personal data collected under the scheme shall be used only for the purposes of the scheme.
[COR1-1] (Rule) In paragraph 3.2 of the G.O. read above, for "Rs. 2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand only)" read "Rs. 3,00,000 (Rupees three lakh only)". The annual family income limit for eligibility is accordingly Rs. 3,00,000 per annum.
[COR1-2] (Info) All other conditions of the G.O. remain unchanged.
[MIN-1] (Mandate) CSC operators shall be permitted to apply on behalf of students who do not have internet access, and the acknowledgement shall be sent to the student's mobile number.
[MIN-2] (Mandate) For renewal applications, documents already verified in the previous year shall be reused and shall not be uploaded again.
[MIN-3] (Mandate) The portal shall be available in Hindi and English.
[MIN-5] (Mandate) The portal shall work on low-end Android phones on 3G connections.
[VB-1] (Mandate) There should also be a mobile application for students, because most students have only a mobile phone.
[VB-2] (Mandate) The District Social Welfare Officer needs a dashboard showing the pending applications of every institution and how long they have been pending.
[VB-3] (Mandate) If an application is rejected, the student should be told the reason for rejection by SMS and be given one chance to correct it and apply again.
